surface: Start.ng Arcade landing and Identity Dash
firstViewport: A live Three.js Lagos night street occupies the first view. A warm roadside NIGHT RUN sign, oversized Identity Dash title, single Start running action, compact three-title shelf, and explicit visitor-identity state appear over the scene.
signatureInteraction: Identity Dash visibly scrolls a three-lane street toward the player. Arrow keys or swipe shift lanes; Space, Up, W, or the touch button jump; coins update the score; collisions reduce three runs; Escape or the pause control pauses.
motionGrammar: Ease lane changes and camera follow; cycle the player's limbs while running; spin coins; use one low-amplitude bounce for jumps; preserve the complete interface for reduced-motion users.
responsive: Desktop uses a wide scene with a narrow right game shelf. Mobile stacks the same scene and shelf, keeps large touch controls reachable, and scales HUD text without clipping.
identityTruth: Identity Dash implements the public Start.ng connect example for signed-in identity and centrally managed style; local preview is marked visitor. Hosted end-to-end integration has not been verified.
